name: mirage
text: Found why they come back. The dead-price memory I added earlier only covered the +EV Feed. The CNO list was only held off for 60 seconds, and then any newer read of Novig's price put the row back, even at the same price nobody sold at. I fixed it in code. A CNO row now stays off while the price read still shows that same price, for up to 30 minutes, and returns at once if the price changes. The test for it passes. It goes out in the next version, along with the star-rating release that the other session is finishing, and I'll tell you the number. I haven't yet worked out why so many orders find nobody selling. I'm looking at that next, using the failed orders against the book at the time.
